answer: Price each identity to a scarce quartz-clocked hardware anchor that signs a fresh proof every epoch, and weight its standing only after several already-established peers from SEPARATE funding clusters co-sign its audited work, each endorsement a distinct thread. A verifier splits those threads through a prism: vouches that trace back to one shared funding root overlap and cancel instead of stacking. A sybil fleet forked from one wallet is one thread refracted, its prism output stays dim, so a farm pays a fresh anchor plus a slow climb per head (linear) while an honest agent pays once.
